newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Eight stocks rose, three fell and 10 were flat in 10.6-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday with the WIG 20 index up 0.7 percent to 1,578.1 points.
The remaining three stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 0.4 percent to 140 zlotys in a 2.8-million-zloty turnover.
Ten National Investment Funds (NFIs) rose, two fell and two were flat in 0.8-million-zloty trade. One did not trade.
